UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Private PII profile for a Google-authenticated user of The Tiebreaker.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sign-in or profile sync.

DecisionDocument.title: DecisionDocument
DecisionDocument.description: A user-owned structured decision analysis containing options, pros/cons, weighted criteria, SWOT, and AI challenges.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the decision owner.

prosCons.description: Weighted pros and cons per option (up to 4 entries).

swot.description: SWOT analysis per option (up to 4 entries).

aiTakeaway.description: Synthesized summary of the core trade-off.

tiebreakerQuestion.description: Decisive question to break a deadlock.

challenges.description: Up to 20 AI stress-test insight entries.

chosenOptionId.description: ID of the selected final option, or empty string if still open.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the decision was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Private PII profile isolated per Google-authenticated user.

/decisions/{decisionId}.description: Private user-owned decision analyses synchronized across devices.
